name: Push A
focus: Heavy pressing strength and upper-body development.

warmup.label: General warm-up
warmup.detail: 5–8 min easy rower, bike or incline walk until you're lightly sweating.

warmup.label: Shoulder mobility
warmup.detail: Band dislocates ×10, wall slides ×10, open-book thoracic rotations ×8 each side.

warmup.label: Activation
warmup.detail: Band pull-aparts ×15, band external rotations ×12 each arm, scap push-ups ×10.

warmup.label: Bench ramp-up
warmup.detail: Empty bar ×10, 50% ×5, 70% ×3, 85% ×1 of today's working weight, then start your working sets.

warmup.label: Feeder sets
warmup.detail: One light set at ~50% ×8 before the incline press and the shoulder press.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.note: Main strength lift. When all 3 sets hit 8 with good form, add 5 lb.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.note: 30° incline for upper chest. Add 5 lb per hand once all sets reach 10.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Elbows slightly forward. Stop if the shoulder pinches.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raises
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

name: Pull A
focus: Back width, thickness, strong biceps and grip.

warmup.label: General warm-up
warmup.detail: 5–8 min easy rower or bike until you're lightly sweating.

warmup.label: Mobility
warmup.detail: Cat-cow ×8, foam-roller thoracic extensions ×10, lat stretch 30 s each side.

warmup.label: Activation
warmup.detail: Band pull-aparts ×15, scap pull-ups ×8, dead hang 20–30 s.

warmup.label: Pull-up ramp-up
warmup.detail: Bodyweight pull-ups ×5, then 50% ×3 and 80% ×1 of today's added load. Pulldown instead: 50% ×10, 70% ×5, 85% ×2.

warmup.label: Feeder sets
warmup.detail: One light set at ~50% ×8 before the row and the first curl.

exercises.name: Weighted Pull-Ups or Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Use the lat pulldown until you can do 6 strict bodyweight reps.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Row
exercises.note: Chest stays on the pad. Drive the elbows back.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Cable Row
exercises.note: Reps per arm. Reach into the stretch, pull the elbow to your hip.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: EZ-Bar Biceps Curl
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Farmer Carries
exercises.note: Heaviest load you can carry with tall posture. Stop when grip opens or posture breaks.

name: Legs A
focus: Maximum lower-body strength, athletic performance and explosive power.

warmup.label: General warm-up
warmup.detail: 5–8 min easy bike or incline walk until you're lightly sweating.

warmup.label: Mobility
warmup.detail: Leg swings ×10 each direction, hip 90/90 switches ×5 each side, ankle rocks ×10 each, deep squat hold 30 s.

warmup.label: Activation
warmup.detail: Glute bridges ×12, lateral band walks ×10 each way, bodyweight squats ×10.

warmup.label: Jump prep
warmup.detail: Pogo hops 2×15, A-skips 2×20 m, low-box (12–18 in) stick landings ×5, then 2 easy box jumps.

warmup.label: Squat ramp-up
warmup.detail: After the jumps: empty bar ×10, 50% ×5, 70% ×3, 85% ×1 of today's working weight.

exercises.name: Box Jumps
exercises.note: Jumps first, while fresh. Full recovery between sets — stop the set the moment height drops. Never to failure.

exercises.name: Volleyball Approach Jumps
exercises.note: Skip when volleyball volume is already high this week.

exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.note: Main strength lift. Safeties set. When all 4 sets hit 6, add 10 lb.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.note: Flat back, bar on your legs. Stop at your hamstring stretch, not the floor.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.note: 8 reps per leg. Start with your weaker leg.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Lean forward slightly and control the return.

exercises.name: Standing Calf Raises
exercises.note: Pause in the stretch. Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raises
exercises.note: Curl the pelvis up at the top. No swinging.

name: Push B
focus: Muscle hypertrophy with emphasis on upper chest, shoulders, and triceps.

warmup.label: General warm-up
warmup.detail: 5–8 min easy rower, bike or incline walk until you're lightly sweating.

warmup.label: Shoulder mobility
warmup.detail: Band dislocates ×10, wall slides ×10, doorway pec stretch 30 s each side.

warmup.label: Activation
warmup.detail: Band pull-aparts ×15, push-ups ×10–15, band external rotations ×12 each arm.

warmup.label: Incline Smith ramp-up
warmup.detail: Empty bar ×10, 50% ×5, 70% ×3, 85% ×1 of today's working weight.

warmup.label: Feeder sets
warmup.detail: One light set at ~50% ×8 before the machine press and the shoulder press.

exercises.name: Incline Smith Machine Press
exercises.note: Upper-chest priority. Bar touches high on the chest. Add load when all sets hit 12.

exercises.name: Machine Chest Press
exercises.note: Slow 2–3 s lowering, full stretch, strong squeeze.

exercises.name: Seated Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.note: Lighter than Monday — smooth, controlled reps.

exercises.name: Cable Lateral Raises
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.note: Low pulleys, sweep up and in for upper chest. Elbow angle stays locked.

exercises.name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Rope Triceps Pushdown
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

name: Pull B
focus: V-taper aesthetics, lat development, arms and forearms.

warmup.label: General warm-up
warmup.detail: 5–8 min easy rower or bike until you're lightly sweating.

warmup.label: Mobility
warmup.detail: Cat-cow ×8, foam-roller thoracic extensions ×10, child's-pose lat stretch 30 s each side.

warmup.label: Activation
warmup.detail: Band pull-aparts ×15, straight-arm band pulldowns ×12, dead hang 20–30 s.

warmup.label: Pulldown ramp-up
warmup.detail: 50% ×10, 70% ×5, 85% ×2 of today's working weight.

warmup.label: Elbows & wrists
warmup.detail: Wrist circles ×10 each way and one light curl set ×15 before the arm work.

exercises.name: Neutral-Grip Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Full stretch at the top, elbows to your hips.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported Wide Row
exercises.note: Elbows wide for upper back and rear delts. No shrugging.

exercises.name: Single-Arm Lat Pulldown
exercises.note: Reps per arm. Pull the elbow down to your hip.

exercises.name: Reverse Pec Deck
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Preacher Curls
exercises.note: Control the bottom. Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Cable Hammer Curls
exercises.note: Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Wrist Curls or Reverse Curls
exercises.note: Pick one per session. Slow reps; stop if your wrists ache.

name: Legs B
focus: Lower-body muscle growth, balanced proportions, calves and core.

warmup.label: General warm-up
warmup.detail: 5–8 min easy bike or incline walk until you're lightly sweating.

warmup.label: Mobility
warmup.detail: Leg swings ×10 each direction, couch stretch 30 s each side, ankle rocks ×10 each.

warmup.label: Activation
warmup.detail: Glute bridges ×12, bodyweight squats ×10, dead bugs ×8 each side.

warmup.label: Jump prep
warmup.detail: If doing broad jumps: pogo hops 2×15, skips 2×20 m, low-box stick landings ×5, then 2 easy broad jumps.

warmup.label: Hack squat ramp-up
warmup.detail: Empty sled ×10, 50% ×5, 70% ×3, 85% ×1 of today's working weight.

exercises.name: Broad Jumps
exercises.note: Optional — skip if legs are fatigued from volleyball.

exercises.name: Hack Squat
exercises.note: Deep, controlled reps. When all sets hit 12, add 10 lb.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: Hips stay on the pad. Don't lock the knees out.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust
exercises.note: Chin tucked, ribs down. Pause and squeeze at the top.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Slow lowering. Lean forward for a deeper stretch.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: Pause for a second at the top of every rep.

exercises.name: Seated Calf Raises
exercises.note: Pause in the stretch. Last set can go to 0–1.

exercises.name: Cable Crunches
exercises.note: Ribs to pelvis — your hips stay still.
